MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The single compact roll of Gorilla Tape felt useful alongside my recent fastening and mounting supplies because it could support small household repairs.",
    "That roll offered a practical amount to keep on hand without requiring a specific plumbing connection or tool fit. It was the only item I would choose now."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Locking nuts and hose clamps are fastening supplies, but they serve different tasks from the framing nails, wood screws, and drywall anchors I recently chose.",
    "The cutting wheels and pipe fitting depend on tools or connections I have not shown a need for, while epoxy and electronic cleaner address different repair tasks.",
    "Eighteen rolls of tape and six cans of lubricant exceed my current needs; accepting a small repair supply does not mean I want to stock up."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in construction fasteners seems to have been stretched into an interest in almost any workshop or maintenance supply.",
    "My purchases of large packs of nails and screws seem to have been treated as a general preference for bulk quantities, even for supplies I would use much less often."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The repeated choices of framing nails, wood screws, and drywall anchors suggest that the fastening material and task matter more to me than simply being useful around a workshop.",
    "Compatibility matters for specialized supplies: buying nails and screws does not establish that I need metal-cutting wheels, hose clamps, or a particular pipe fitting.",
    "Quantity depends on the job. I may need many fasteners for construction but only one small roll of tape for occasional repairs."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "You recognized my interest in practical repair supplies but extended it too broadly beyond my recent wood fastening and mounting needs."
}
